id: title:Gilbert09:treat a corrupt export archive as retryable

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion activity recovery and reliability
review.reason: Adds exception handling for zipfile.BadZipFile, gzip.BadGzipFile, and EOFError, explicitly categorized as retryable errors. This allows warehouse ingestion activities to recover from transient or recoverable archive corruption rather than permanently failing, supporting the warehouse ingestion and data warehouse products.
